pages.title: Leve · Today’s time and events in the Mac menu bar
pages.description: Leve keeps today’s time and today’s events at the edge of your attention, in the macOS menu bar, so deep focus never costs you a meeting. Free and open source.

sections.title: Time stays in view, quietly.
sections.lead: When you hyperfocus, time disappears. Leve keeps it in view without asking for attention. It has no window to manage.

cards.title: One short line in the menu bar
cards.text: It says “Free until 2:00 PM”, “in 12 min” or “20 min left”, never the event’s name, so it is safe on a shared screen.

cards.title: A notification first
cards.text: A notification arrives a few minutes before each event.

cards.title: A calm full screen
cards.text: Just before an event, a calm alert covers every display, with a Join button, until you join or close it.

cards.title: It says the time
cards.text: Leve says the time on the half hour during the day, says the next event two minutes before it starts, and stays quiet during events.

cards.title: Breaks, when you want them
cards.text: Leve can ask for a break after a stretch of work. Take It Later leaves “Break due” beside the icon until you take it. A break never pauses your music on its own.

cards.title: Each calendar its own level
cards.text: All alerts, No full screen, No alerts, or Hidden, for each calendar. Pause everything for 30 minutes, an hour, or until tomorrow.

sections.title: Your calendars stay on your Mac.

paragraphs.text: Leve reads today’s events from the calendars on this Mac and keeps its settings on this Mac. It never changes your calendars.

The only thing it sends over the network is the update check: it reads Leve’s update feed on GitHub, once a day or when you choose Check for Updates… in the menu. Nothing about you, your Mac or your calendars leaves it. You can turn automatic checks off in Settings.
Today only, by design: no tasks, no notes, no event editing, nothing about tomorrow until midnight.

paragraphs.html: Leve is MIT licensed software developed by Marton Paulo.

paragraphs.text: No telemetry. No account. Update checks are Leve’s only network activity.
